entries.en: Vertex: add support for Web Search on supported models
entries.zh: Vertex：支持的模型现在可使用网页搜索

entries.en: VSCode: Adding the respectGitIgnore configuration to include .gitignored files in file searches (defaults to true)
entries.zh: VS Code：新增 respectGitIgnore 配置，可在文件搜索中包含被 .gitignore 忽略的文件（默认为 true）

entries.en: Windows: native installation uses shift+tab as shortcut for mode switching, instead of alt+m
entries.zh: Windows：原生安装版改用 shift+tab 切换模式，不再用 alt+m

entries.en: Fixed a bug with subagents and MCP servers related to "Tool names must be unique" error
entries.zh: 修复了与“工具名称必须是唯一的”错误相关的子代理和 MCP 服务器的错误

entries.en: Fixed issue causing `/compact` to fail with `prompt_too_long` by making it respect existing compact boundaries
entries.zh: 修复了导致`/compact`因`prompt_too_long`而失败的问题，使其尊重现有的紧凑边界

entries.en: Fixed plugin uninstall not removing plugins
entries.zh: 修复了插件卸载不删除插件的问题
